feedback: The run's spec had no devsystem.test role yet, and the Android repo had zero tests -- assembleDebug only proved the scaffold compiles, not that it behaves correctly. Added a stable view id (scaffold_status_text) to MainActivity's TextView and a Robolectric JVM unit test asserting it displays R.string.status_scaffold. Verified hermetically inside mingc/android-build-box: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 1 test / 0 failures (real JUnit XML report); re-ran ./gradlew assembleDebug to confirm no regression. Found and fixed a real bug along the way: the new ids.xml's own comment used '--', invalid inside an XML comment (SAXParseException) -- caught before committing. Commit CADS-webconference-android@0bbdb2e.

proposals.rationale: The test stage is now real for this run: a genuine Robolectric unit test verifies MainActivity's actual displayed text, not just that the project compiles. No new build service was needed -- the same mingc/android-build-box image already used for assembleDebug also runs ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest, so this proposal reuses an existing service rather than requesting a new one.
proposals.use_existing_service: mingc/android-build-box (already in use for assembleDebug; ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest runs in the same hermetic container)
